This page provides a list of 'modern' PIE personal names, mandatorily breakable only to PIE roots from:
*[http://lrc.la.utexas.edu/lex/master Indogermanisches etymologisches Wörterbuch]
*[http://www.koeblergerhard.de/idgwbhin.html Indogermanisches Wörterbuch]
*[http://www.koeblergerhard.de/wikiling/?f=idg WikiLing] searchable database
These names must be cognate matching, and thus cannot be changed to non-cognates. They should be used as said on the [[Wp/ine/List of articles we need to have|List of articles we need to have]]. This list of PIE names also includes more peripheral names of the same origin.
